summary: Cushman & Wakefield Ltd. filed an 8-K regarding an expected amendment to its existing Credit Agreement by its subsidiaries. The amendment will reprice $848 million of term loans (2026-1 Term Loans) with a SOFR+2.25% margin, extend maturity to 2033, and upsize by $353 million. No stock price, premium, or board recommendation is provided. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. The remaining $840 million term loans (2025-3) are unchanged. No watch items or risk-arb angles apply.
